name: The Word
overview: Scripture reveals the Word as both divine and powerful, beginning with John 1:1 which declares the Word was with God and was God. The Word serves as a guiding light in the believer's life, as Psalm 119:105 describes it as a lamp to our feet and a light to our path. Jesus Himself affirms the necessity of living by every word from God (Matthew 4:4), highlighting its sustaining spiritual power. Hebrews 4:12 further emphasizes the Word's penetrating ability to discern the thoughts and intentions of the heart, demonstrating its vital role in teaching, preaching, and spreading the truth of Christ.
